art_direction: 冰蓝卫星的裂隙与两股细雾喷泉被逆光照亮，远处巨大暗行星只露一角。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Show an icy moon in three-quarter view, its pale surface crossed by a few long blue fractures and subtle ridges. Two slender vapor plumes rise from the sunlit limb, catching cold backlight against space. A much larger dark planet appears only as a soft partial curve far behind, giving scale without competing with the moon. Keep the icy body near the center and let its textured surface carry the detail. Use restrained blue-white lighting, no explosive eruption, spacecraft, or dramatic debris. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
